7591308975946222879.desc: Steal my 10-day Japan itinerary for Tokyo & Kyoto. Full cost at the end! 🇯🇵✨ Obviously, there’s so much to do in Japan, but for 10 days I feel like this is a very thorough layout, with enough space to do more or adjust for extra day trips. For example, you could easily add a day trip to Nara or Osaka, but we chose to skip them. If you prefer more nature than city, I’d recommend reducing days in Tokyo this might be an unpopular opinion 🫣 but if I were planning it again, I would. PS I’m happy to answer any questions in the comments!

7623125371055017247.desc: 🇮🇪 3 days in Ireland’s hidden gem - County Tipperary is the itinerary you didn't know you needed 👇 Lonely Planet recently recognized this as a top destination for 2026 and after spending a few days here myself, I can say it's been flying under the radar for way too long. If you want to experience traditional Irish culture without the crowds, this is it. And the best part? This 3 day itinerary sets you up perfectly to continue west to the Wild Atlantic Way ✈️ so you can easily continue on to places like the Cliffs of Moher, Dingle Peninsula or The Ring of Kerry. Here's the full 3-day breakdown: DAY 1️⃣ — Carrick-on-Suir to Cahir 📍 Start your morning at Ormond Castle, then browse local art and handmade goods at the Tudor Artisan Hub 🥘 Stop for lunch and a pint at The Carraig Hotel  🚴 Grab a rental from Blueway Bike Hire and ride the Suir Blueway toward the town of Clonmel - the scenery is unreal 🏰 End the day at Cahir Castle — one of the best-preserved castles in all of Ireland DAY 2️⃣ — Rock of Cashel to The Glen of Aherlow and Terryglass 📍 Make a pit stop at the Rock of Cashel — the medieval architecture alone is worth the visit 🍽️ Head into the Glen of Aherlow and grab lunch at the Aherlow House Hotel for epic views and amazing food ⛪ Spend the afternoon hitting Moor Abbey, the Christ the King viewpoint overlooking the valley, and the Duntryleague Ruins 🎵 Drive north through Nenagh toward Terryglass, follow parts of the Shane MacGowan Self-Guided Tour 🍻 Wrap up with dinner and a pint of Guinness at Paddy’s in Terryglass DAY 3️⃣ — Lough Derg 🚤 Full-day experience with Derg Lake Tours exploring Lough Derg by boat 🧖 Stop at the Ritual Sauna experience — rotate between the sauna with an epic view and a dip in the lake (don't forget your swimsuit!) 🍴 Finish with lunch at @larkinsbar right on the water Now you’re setup perfectly to continue west to the Wild Atlantic Way 👋🏻  Save this for your next trip to Ireland and safe travels! 🇮🇪 #ireland #countytipperary #irelandtravel #wildatlanticway #tourismireland
